With over 30 years experience, NYC Fireplaces & Outdoor Kitchens has been Manhattan NY’s trusted source for luxury fireplace design, supply, and installation. Our factory-trained team is an authorized dealer for all the brands we carry and is backed by 300+ five-star Google reviews. See all our products in person at our designer showroom located in Maspeth, NY (Queens) and Greenvale, NY (Nassau County).

We’re authorized dealers for every brand we carry, and our staff is factory-trained directly by the manufacturers of the fireplace products we supply — ensuring expert recommendations and proper installation

Complete Fireplace Services

Our team provides end-to-end fireplace solutions, including:

  • Design consultation and specification review
  • Product sourcing and supply for all fireplace types
  • Installation & coordination with your GC, architect, or interior designer
  • Custom mantels, surrounds, and fireplace doors
  • Media walls, built-ins, and cabinetry integration
  • On-site layout guidance and technical documentation

Fireplaces We Offer

Gas Fireplaces

Direct-vent models for any home style.

Electric Fireplaces

Perfect for condos, apartments, and townhouses.

Ethanol Fireplaces

Clean-burning vent-free flames with modern appeal.

Water-Vapor Fireplaces

Realistic flame illusion using illuminated vapor.

Wood Fireplaces

Authentic, high-efficiency traditional hearths.

Fireplace Inserts & Log Sets

Upgrade old units with modern technology.

Vent-Free Fireplaces

(Ideal for Condos & Apartments)

Many homes in Manhattan NY can’t accommodate a flue or chimney. That’s why we carry a full range of vent-free electric, ethanol, and water-vapor fireplaces that deliver beauty and comfort without venting:

  • No chimney or gas line required
  • Safe and clean for indoor use
  • Simple plug-in or recessed installation
  • Realistic flames with zero emissions
  • Perfect for condos, co-ops, apartments, and high-rises

Mantels, Doors & Media Walls

Elevate your space with tailored craftsmanship

Mantels

in wood, stone, or metal finishes

Fireplace doors

in glass, wrought iron, or frameless designs

Media walls & built-in cabinetry

that seamlessly integrate your TV and fireplace

  • Designer showroom with working displays.

DaVinci, Fireplace Xtrordinair, Montigo, Kozy Heat, NetZero, Camina & Schmid, Modern Flames, Dimplex, Napoleon, Majestic, and more

Complete Fireplace Services

Our team provides end-to-end fireplace solutions, including:

  • Design consultation and specification review
  • Product sourcing and supply for all fireplace types

  • Media walls, built-ins, and cabinetry integration

Fireplaces We Offer

Gas Fireplaces

Direct-vent models for any home style.

Electric Fireplaces

Perfect for condos, apartments, and townhouses.

Ethanol Fireplaces

Clean-burning vent-free flames with modern appeal.

Water-Vapor Fireplaces

Realistic flame illusion using illuminated vapor.

Wood Fireplaces

Authentic, high-efficiency traditional hearths.

Fireplace Inserts & Log Sets

Upgrade old units with modern technology.

Vent-Free Fireplaces

(Ideal for Condos & Apartments)

Many homes in New Jersey can’t accommodate a flue or chimney. That’s why we carry a full range of vent-free electric, ethanol, and water-vapor fireplaces that deliver beauty and comfort without venting:

  • No chimney or gas line required
  • Safe and clean for indoor use
  • Simple plug-in or recessed installation
  • Realistic flames with zero emissions
  • Perfect for condos, co-ops, apartments, and high-rises

Luxury Fireplace Showroom, Supply & Installation — Nassau County

30+ years. Gas, electric, ethanol & water-vapor, including vent-free options for Nassau County homes without a chimney. See them lit at our Greenvale showroom.

Get My Free Design & Quote (718) 326-4328
30+ Years Experience
Over 300 5 Google Reviews
2-Day Typical Install
Free 3D Design

With over 30 years experience, NYC Fireplaces & Outdoor Kitchens has been Nassau County’s trusted source for luxury fireplace design, supply, and installation. Our factory-trained team is an authorized dealer for all the brands we carry and is backed by 300+ five-star Google reviews. See all our products in person at our designer showroom located in Maspeth, NY (Queens) and Greenvale, NY (Nassau County).

We’re authorized dealers for every brand we carry, and our staff is factory-trained directly by the manufacturers of the fireplace products we supply — ensuring expert recommendations and proper installation

Complete Fireplace Services

Our team provides end-to-end fireplace solutions, including:

  • Design consultation and specification review
  • Product sourcing and supply for all fireplace types
  • Installation & coordination with your GC, architect, or interior designer
  • Custom mantels, surrounds, and fireplace doors
  • Media walls, built-ins, and cabinetry integration
  • On-site layout guidance and technical documentation

Fireplaces We Offer

Gas Fireplaces

Direct-vent models for any home style.

Electric Fireplaces

Perfect for condos, apartments, and townhouses.

Ethanol Fireplaces

Clean-burning vent-free flames with modern appeal.

Water-Vapor Fireplaces

Realistic flame illusion using illuminated vapor.

Wood Fireplaces

Authentic, high-efficiency traditional hearths.

Fireplace Inserts & Log Sets

Upgrade old units with modern technology.

Vent-Free Fireplaces

(Ideal for Condos & Apartments)

Many homes in Nassau County can’t accommodate a flue or chimney. That’s why we carry a full range of vent-free electric, ethanol, and water-vapor fireplaces that deliver beauty and comfort without venting:

  • No chimney or gas line required
  • Safe and clean for indoor use
  • Simple plug-in or recessed installation
  • Realistic flames with zero emissions
  • Perfect for condos, co-ops, apartments, and high-rises

Mantels, Doors & Media Walls

Elevate your space with tailored craftsmanship

Mantels

in wood, stone, or metal finishes

Fireplace doors

in glass, wrought iron, or frameless designs

Media walls & built-in cabinetry

that seamlessly integrate your TV and fireplace

Why Choose NYC Fireplaces & Outdoor Kitchens

  • Family-owned & run business with 30+ years of experience
  • Elite team of in-house craftsmen, installers, technicians and designers
  • Authorized dealer for all brands we carry
  • Factory-trained staff & installers for accurate technical guidance
  • 300+ five-star Google reviews from satisfied clients
  • Designer showroom with working displays.

Premium brands including:

DaVinci, Fireplace Xtrordinair, Montigo, Kozy Heat, NetZero, Camina & Schmid, Modern Flames, Dimplex, Napoleon, Majestic, and more

Water Vapor Fireplaces

Explore the modern innovation of Water Vapor Fireplaces at NYC Fireplaces and Outdoor Kitchens. These eco-friendly fireplaces use advanced ultrasonic technology to create incredibly realistic, cool-to-the-touch flames using only water. Enjoy safe, smoke-free ambiance without the need for venting or fuel. Ideal for contemporary interiors, commercial spaces, or anywhere you want stunning flame visuals without heat. Contact us to learn more and bring cutting-edge design to your home or business.

title.rendered: Get Started With An Outdoor Kitchen

content.rendered:
Get Started With An Outdoor Kitchen

From NYC Fireplaces

Our Outdoor Kitchen Project Process

At NYC Fireplaces & Outdoor Kitchens, we pride ourselves on guiding you through every step of creating your dream outdoor kitchen. Our process is designed to be seamless, transparent, and enjoyable, ensuring that your vision comes to life exactly as you imagined.

Get Familiar.
Get Inspired.
Get Cooking.

START DESIGNING

Example Outdoor Kitchens

$10k - $15k

Submit Inquiry

$15k - $20k

Submit Inquiry

$20k - $30k

Submit Inquiry

$30k - $40k

Submit Inquiry

$40 - $50k

Submit Inquiry

$50k - $60k+

Submit Inquiry

Get Familiar

Your journey begins with a comprehensive consultation. We take the time to understand your preferences, lifestyle, and budget, engaging in detailed discussions about the features, layout, and materials you desire. We may also conduct a site visit to assess your space and take accurate measurements, ensuring our design will fit perfectly into your outdoor area.

View Our Portfolio

Get Inspired

With the information gathered, our design team crafts detailed plans and 3D renderings of your proposed outdoor kitchen. We collaborate closely with you, incorporating your feedback and making any necessary adjustments to ensure the design aligns with your vision. Once you're thrilled with the design, we provide a comprehensive quote and project timeline.

View Our Portfolio

Get Cooking

The project concludes with a final walkthrough and inspection. We ensure every detail meets our high standards and your expectations before handing over your completed outdoor kitchen. Our goal is to deliver a space where you can create lasting memories with family and friends.

At NYC Fireplaces & Outdoor Kitchens, we're committed to making your outdoor kitchen project an exciting and rewarding experience from start to finish. Contact us today to begin your journey!

Schedule a Free Design Visit

Coastal Grill Island Packages

Coastal Grill Islands from Challenger Designs offer pre-assembled ease when adding a kitchen to an outdoor area. These powder-coated aluminum islands can include any grill 32” or smaller and arrive pre-assembled with attached aluminum countertop.

Empire stocks Coastal Grill Island Packages in three sizes and color combos, which include your choice of three different Blaze grills.

More configurations are available, including Torch Carts designed to support ceramic grills.

Shop Now

Challenger Coastal Collection

For pre-configured grill islands, Challenger’s Coastal Collection provides a “no assembly” solution for aluminum
outdoor kitchens. Empire stocks three packages which include your choice of three different Blaze grills. With
multiple color combinations that ship directly from our warehouse, this quick option still allows for choice.

Features

  • Weather-Sealed Cabinets
    The only weather-resistant outdoor kitchen cabinets with
    standard weather-sealing to keep belongings protected
    from the elements.
  • Short Lead Times for Delivery
    Three units are in-stock and ready to ship from our
    warehouse.
  • Crafted from Powder-Coated Aluminum
    Cabinets won’t warp or rot, even in direct sun or cold
    conditions.
  • Stainless Steel, Self-Leveling Legs Great for Decks or Rooftops
    A snap to install on most flat surfaces including decks and
    rooftops. Finish with a color-matched toe kick for a built-in
    look.
  • Aluminum Countertops
    High-quality aluminum countertops are weather proof
    and easy to care for.
  • Fully-assembled - Quick to Install
    Coastal units come fully assembled. Simply install your
    appliances and you’re ready to cook!
  • Finished Back Panel Standard
    Essential for installing cabinets as a freestanding island, or
    on a deck where the back of the kitchen will be exposed.
  • Made in the USA
    Limited Lifetime Warranty
    Built start to finish in the United States. Challenger
    Designs, LLC warrants to the original consumer purchaser,
    for as long as they own their cabinet, that products shall
    be free from defects in manufactured materials and
    workmanship under normal use.

Once you understand the many advantages of gas fireplace products, you’ll be glad to know that Real Fyre offers more than 40 authentic styles of gas log sets, each exceptional beautiful, with or without the fire burning. Simply put, you won’t find gas fireplace products more beautifully designed and expertly engineered than Real Fyre. Many of our log designs are individually hand painted by craftsman and artists who have been mastering their artistry in our workshops for generations.

Once you understand the many advantages of gas fireplace products, you’ll be glad to know that Real Fyre offers more than 40 authentic styles of gas log sets, each exceptional beautiful, with or without the fire burning. And our beauty is not just skin deep. Beyond being the most realistic looking gas logs you can buy, Real Fyre gas fireplace products are also made of the finest materials and engineered to last.

Real Fyre brings you and your family all the warmth, comfort and beauty you’d ever wish for from a hearth place fire, without any of the drawbacks of wood burning fires.

Simply put, you won’t find gas fireplace products more beautifully designed and expertly engineered than Real Fyre. Many of our log designs are individually hand painted by craftsman and artists who have been mastering their artistry in our workshops for generations.

Once you understand the many advantages of gas fireplace products, you’ll be glad to know that Real Fyre offers more than 40 authentic styles of gas log sets, each exceptional beautiful, with or without the fire burning. FAQs - Fireplaces

Why buy a fireplace?

Fireplaces not only add warmth to your home but add value & save on heating cost

From the beginning of time, man was drawn to fire. At first it afforded protection from the dangers of the dark; shelter from the bitter cold; and a means of digesting the indigestible.

As man evolved, the fascination with fire never dimmed: The romantic notion of staring into smoldering embers; the welcoming warmth of the hearth on a cold winter's night; the fun of watching marshmallows going from snowy white to charred ebony and melt onto the logs from the end of a pointy stick.

Fireplaces of today have been transformed from a heat and light source to an aesthetically pleasing accessory designed as an inviting focal point in any room as well as providing warmth.

Aside from adding value to your home, a fireplace creates an oasis of tranquility and peace within your own private world.

NYC Fireplaces & Outdoor Kitchens with over 30 years of experience in the building industry can customize our vast selection of products to complement any space.

From the traditional wood burning to the latest fuel efficient models, there is a fireplace that's a perfect fit for your home and needs.

I'm looking for framing dimensions and BTU ratings on a particular unit, can you help me?

For combustible clearances, unit and framing dimensions, please consult the manufacturer website. There you will find installation manuals, diagrams, high resolution photos of the products and accessories. If you are having trouble finding the website, give us a call and we can direct you.

I have an existing wood burning fireplace, but I want to convert it to gas. What are my options?

For masonry or factory built fireplaces you have two options:A sealed gas insert will slide into your existing firebox, providing supplemental heat and ambiance. These units require an existing chimney and include a glass front.
The alternate option is a gas log set or glass burner. This type of unit creates more of an aesthetic presence than heat. These units do not come with a glass front, but doors are available if desired. The burner is assembled and connected to a gas line within the firebox.

What is a direct vent gas fireplace?

Fireplaces that use venting material for intake and exhaust are categorized as direct vent fireplaces. A chimney is not required to vent these units; only galvanized double-wall vent pipe is required. If you do not have a preexisting fireplace, this is the category of hearth products for you. These units require a glass pane face – this is how the heat is transferred into your room.

Does the glass get hot?

YES. The glass does get hot. Most manufacturers supply screens to prevent direct contact with the glass.

I want a Majestic fireplace with a Town & Country burner. Is this possible?

No. Each manufacturer tests their units with their own parts. We cannot "mix & match" fireplace elements.

I have 42" of wall space. Can I use a 42" wide firebox?

Most likely, no. What you do not see around the firebox is framing, gypsum board and non combustible clearances. These distances differ from manufacturer to manufacturer. Consult the applicable installation manual for further detail or call us.

Do you have pre-made mantels in stock?

No. Each mantel is custom made to your fireplace dimensions. You can select from our fabricator's styles or bring in a photo of something you like. We can reproduce most mantels.

I live in a condo and cannot vent, but would like a fireplace. What are my options?

There are plenty of vent free options! The simplest of all are electric fireplaces. They work with a regular 110 outlet and are offered in several styles including: wall-mounted, built-in, cabinets or media centers. Another option is bio ethanol, a corn based fuel poured into a reservoir and lit manually or automatically. Bio ethanol fireplaces offer a real flame, but are primarily used for decoration.

I have a question about building code, can you help me?

We are not responsible for building code. The building code differs from county to county. We install per the manufacturer's specifications, providing a safe, effective and warranted appliance. We recommend calling your local architect or fire department for code compliance questions.

Do you fabricate custom fireplaces?

Yes, but they are not for everyone. Custom fireplaces do not come with a UL rating. Custom work is generally very costly; obtaining a UL rating will make fabrication even more expensive. Non-refundable deposits are required for surveys and drawings.

I have a fireplace I bought online. Can you install it for me?

Unfortunately, no. Online retailers cannot be trusted. They can be selling defective, pre-owned, used or even stolen merchandise that could cause potential problems following installation.

My wood/gas fireplace needs servicing. Can you help me?

We do not provide cleaning services for wood fireplaces. Serving our existing customers takes priority on our schedule, especially during the winter months. Please contact us with make, model and a brief description of the problem or issue.

Can I buy the fireplace from you and have my contractor install it?

Sure, but has your contractor installed fireplaces before? Is he familiar with these brands? Is he authorized by the manufacturer? If you've answered no to these questions, you may want to reconsider! Our installation team has over 15 years of experience with these appliances and has encountered almost every unit on the market. When dealing with gas appliances and carbon monoxide levels, you should leave it to the experts.

FAQs Outdoor Kitchen

Are your products available in natural gas and propane?

Yes, most of the grills we carry can be converted for use with either fuel.

What is the difference between your high-end grills and my Weber?

Many of our manufacturers provide warranties on their burners and grids; the most commonly replaced parts. These are lifetime grills, perfect for outdoor kitchen constructions. Stainless steel housings, wide temperature ranges and state-of-the-art technology features separate the tailgating grill from the lifetime grill. If you are someone takes grilling seriously, stop by and visit the showroom for further information.

I have a contractor currently working on my home. Can I have them construct the kitchen and purchase the equipment from you?

Yes. We always recommend having the appliances on hand before starting any fine work - something as small as a screw or flange could create a major problem.

    • Yes. Most modern gas fireplaces used in new construction are direct vent fireplaces, which do not require a traditional chimney. These units vent through an exterior wall or roof using sealed venting systems.

      This makes them ideal for new construction, renovations, and homes where a masonry chimney is not present.

      We frequently help builders and architects select direct vent fireplaces that fit the design of the home while ensuring the venting path works within the structure of the building.

    • For new construction projects, architects and builders most commonly specify direct vent gas fireplaces because they provide high efficiency, flexible venting options, and modern design possibilities such as linear fireplaces and large viewing areas.

      The correct fireplace depends on several factors including the building layout, available venting paths, the desired aesthetic, and the project's heating goals. Vent-Free Fireplaces like electric, ethanol, or water-vapor are sometimes used when venting is not possible, while gas inserts are typically used only when converting an existing wood-burning fireplace.

      Our team regularly works with builders and architects to review floor plans, recommend appropriate fireplace models, and help determine the best venting strategy for the project.

    • Clearances vary depending on the manufacturer and model, but all fireplaces require specific spacing between the unit, framing, and combustible materials such as wood studs, drywall, and mantels.

      Modern direct vent fireplaces often allow tight clearances that work well in contemporary media walls and built-in fireplace designs.

      We help builders and designers review manufacturer specifications and clearance requirements to ensure the fireplace installation is planned correctly before construction begins.

    • Gas lines must be sized correctly to supply the total BTU demand of all connected appliances, including fireplaces, grills, side burners, and other outdoor kitchen equipment.

      Factors such as pipe length, gas meter capacity, and the number of appliances being installed can affect gas line sizing.

      We frequently work with builders and contractors to determine appliance BTU requirements so the appropriate gas line sizing can be planned early in the project.

    • In many cases fireplaces can be installed in condos or apartments depending on the building structure and available venting options. Direct vent fireplaces may be possible when exterior venting is available, while vent-free ethanol, water-vapor or electric fireplaces are often used when venting is not feasible.

      Because condo and co-op buildings can have additional restrictions, early planning is important. We regularly assist homeowners, designers, and contractors with fireplace solutions for condos and apartments.

    • During new construction, fireplace installation is typically completed in stages. The fireplace unit is often installed during framing so venting and gas lines can be routed properly, while finishing work such as mantels or media walls is completed later in the project.

      Installation timelines vary depending on the complexity of the design and the construction schedule. Our team regularly coordinates with builders and contractors to ensure fireplace installations align with the project timeline.

    • A gas fireplace insert is designed to be installed inside an existing wood-burning fireplace, while a direct vent fireplace is typically installed in new construction or where no fireplace currently exists. Because the two terms are often confused, many homeowners request a “gas insert” even when they actually need a direct vent fireplace.

Professional Installation

Our Expert Team Ensures Perfection

Our company installs & services in the following areas: Manhattan, Queens, Brooklyn, Nassau, Suffolk, Staten Island, Bronx, Westchester NY. Hudson, Union, Essex, & Bergen NJ. Greenwich & Stamford, CT.

We only install units that we have sold that are new directly from the manufacturer.

Why is professional installation important?

Whether gas or wood burning, it’s vitally important that your hearth appliance is installed correctly by professional and experienced fireplace installation experts. Because flames emit carbon monoxide, hearths must be properly ventilated in order to ensure that you don’t accidentally expose your family and loved ones to potentially dangerous fumes. We are authorized dealers for every brand we carry and each member of our installation team is factory-trained. Gas or wood fireplace installation is beyond the capabilities of a contractor or handyman to do it themselves. The same goes for outdoor, we receive daily calls to fix kitchens/fireplaces with incorrect framing that caught on fire. Leave it to the professionals for peace of mind.

This Privacy Policy describes NYC Fireplaces' policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of your information when you use our service and tells you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

We use your personal data to provide and improve the Service. By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

NYC Fireplaces is committed to safeguarding the privacy of our users. We want to assure you that we do not share your personal information with third parties. This privacy policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect the information you provide to us.

INFORMATION COLLECTION:

We collect only the information necessary to provide and improve our services. This may include your name, email address and phone number. We do not sell, rent, or share this information with any third parties.

HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION:

The information collected is used solely for communicating with you as the intended party. We do not share your information with external parties for marketing or any other purposes. Additionally, no mobile or messaging consent information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

We may use personal data for the following purposes:

  • To provide and maintain our service, including to monitor the usage of our service.
  • To manage your Account: to manage your registration as a user of the Service. The Personal Data you provide can give you access to different functionalities of the Service that are available to you as a registered user.
  • For the performance of a contract: the development, compliance and undertaking of the purchase contract for the products, items or services you have purchased or of any other contract with us through the Service.
  • To contact You: To contact you by email, telephone calls, SMS, or other equivalent forms of electronic communication, such as a mobile application's push notifications regarding updates or informative communications related to the functionalities, products or contracted services, including the security updates, when necessary or reasonable for their implementation.
  • To provide you with news, special offers and general information about other goods, services and events which we offer that are similar to those that you have already purchased or enquired about unless you have opted not to receive such information.
  • To manage your requests: To attend and manage your requests to us.

All messages you send through the Service, whether to us or other users, are stored on our servers. NYC Fireplaces employs servers and services owned by third parties to retain these messages.

DISCLOSURE OF YOUR INFORMATION

NYC Fireplaces does not share any client data with third parties for marketing, promotional purposes, or any other purposes. Your personal information is kept confidential and is not disclosed to any outside organizations, except as required by law or with your explicit consent. We may disclose your personal Information under the following limited circumstances:

  • We have obtained your consent.
  • We need to enforce our Terms of Service.
  • We share information with partners or affiliates that have signed non-disclosure agreements with us only to provide you with a specific service.
  • We may provide such information to a company controlled by or under common control with NYC Fireplaces for any purpose allowed by this Policy.
  • We respond to subpoenas, court orders, or legal processes, or to establish or exercise our legal rights, or the legal rights of others, or defend against legal claims.
  • When we believe it is necessary to disclose Personal Information to investigate, prevent, or take action regarding illegal activities, suspected fraud, potential threats to anyone’s physical safety, violations of NYC Fireplaces Terms of Service, or as otherwise required by law.
  • We transfer Personal Information about you if NYC Fireplaces or its assets are acquired by or merged with another company.

We may share aggregated, non-identifiable information with others without further notice to you, such as the total number of people who used the Service in a specific month or the total number of messages sent during a particular period.

INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS

Your Personal Information may be transferred to and processed in locations outside of your state, province, country, or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ from those in your jurisdiction. We take steps to ensure that your data is handled securely and in line with this Policy, regardless of where it is processed.

DATA RETENTION

We retain your Personal Information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. We will also retain and use your Personal Information as necessary to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

COOKIES AND TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES

Our Service may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience. Cookies are small text files placed on your device to collect information about your activity on the Service. You can control the use of cookies through your browser settings, but disabling cookies may limit your ability to use certain features of the page or Service.

YOUR CHOICES:

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your information. If you have any concerns or questions about your data, please contact us at 718-326-4328.

Policy Changes:

We may update our privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be communicated to you, and your continued use of our services implies your acceptance of the updated policy. By using our services, you agree to the terms outlined in this privacy policy.

Last updated: 11/26/25

Alfa Forni

Domestic pizza ovens

Our drive for continuous innovation allows us to make the best use of latest technologies for cooking, grilling and roasting like a true expert. Each Alfa oven is the result of 100% Italian craftsmanship with an international twist.

Alfa ovens: fast and high-performance appliances

Thanks to continuous innovation process, Alfa ovens deliver the goods. They light up quickly, heat up to 500°C (1000°F) in only ten minutes and can cook a pizza in one minute thus reducing energy consumption and waiting times. To save you more time you can clean them up in just 5 minutes.

Display Models (1) Models (16) Shop Online

Modern Flames

Modern Flames is known as an innovative leader in contemporary electric fireplace design and technology for residential and commercial environments. Pioneering the introduction of the modern linear electric fireplace throughout North America in 2008, the style has since set the standard for architects, designers, builders, and homeowners due to the ultra-realistic flame appearance paired with the ease of installation and affordability.

Our selection of sleek, modern fireplaces evolves every year and are developed by our hearth experts in Arizona with our community in mind, from concept to completion.

We enlist the minds of experts in design and architecture to inform our future product lines. Using their insights and trend forecasting techniques to stay ahead of the competition.

Our offerings are not limited to our core collections, our community has the opportunity to create customized products to better suit their projects due to our exclusive manufacturing capabilities.

We pride ourselves on prioritizing partnerships and seeking out opportunities to showcase our fireplaces because works of art should be shared through online and offline experiences.

Kozy Heat®

We offer a complete line of gas & wood fireplaces and stylish accessories to complement any decor. Adding a fireplace is one of the best ways to increase the value of your home and we are proud to offer a network of dealers throughout the country to help make your experience everything that you imagine. We pride ourselves in being dedicated to not only function and reliability, but customer safety as well.

We are a privately-held, family-owned business. Our customers, suppliers and employees like to work with us because of our small town work ethics and our sincere friendly attitude. We will continue to uphold our fireplace’s reputation of quality and value and we are proud to put our family name, Hussong Manufacturing, on every product we sell.

Danver Stainless Outdoor Kitchens

With many options to choose from, we understand the importance of finding the highest-quality outdoor kitchens suitable for every environment and built to last.

  • Danver Stainless Outdoor Kitchens’ craftsmanship and design flexibility is unrivaled, making Danver the leading outdoor kitchen manufacturer for nearly 20 years.
  • Danver makes it a priority to work with and alongside designers, architects and builders to create the perfect outdoor kitchen, innovating to their needs.
  • We manufacture our cabinets with top quality stainless steel and materials to ensure longevity and a flawless finish.
  • Our stainless steel cabinets are manufactured and engineered in-house in Wallingford, CT and provide customers around the world with the quality they expect.
  • Danver is more than just made in America, best-in-class materials; it’s experience, design and so much more.

Hestan

Award-winning innovation.
Purpose-built performance.

As a company, Hestan is built upon a shared love of food and innovation. We believe the kitchen is a place of collaboration and celebration. This is evident in the name “Hestan” itself – a blend of founders Helen and Stanley Cheng’s names. For it was their passion for exceptional food and wine that brought together the extended Hestan family of chefs, vintners, designers and engineers.

After pioneering nonstick cookware in the 1970s, Stanley Cheng’s inventive spirit led him to the commercial kitchen. Then Hestan changed the game for outdoor cooking. And now, the home kitchen. Above all, Helen, Stanley and the Hestan team delight in the details of cooking – celebrating and elevating every nuance of the culinary experience.
